instruction: You are facing towards a window, turn around and go forward towards the opened brown door, exit this room, turn left and go forward, slightly turn right and go forward towards the entrance, slightly turn right and go forward towards the bed, turn right and go forward towards the brown door, turn right and pass through the opened brown door, turn left and go one step forward, turn left and go downstairs completely, after going downstairs turn left and go forward until you reach a pillar on to your right side, here beside the pillar you have reached the destination.
